body:
I'm not sure this is correct, in `_determine_swap_chain_format` we set the format to `BGR8` which would be a terrible format for HDR.

For devices that don't support any formats aside from one undefined format (which should be extremely rare), I think the safer thing to do is assume HDR isn't supported.

Not a blocker though since this is probably very rare.
Applied (and added a comment to justify it).
